product_family: Open-source framework and cloud platform for building, deploying, and scaling real-time voice, video, and physical AI agents. Core products: Agent Platform (orchestration, STT/LLM/TTS inference gateway, observability), Media Server (WebRTC/SIP infrastructure), Cloud Dashboard, SDKs (Python, Node.js, Web).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Independently audited against the AICPA's Trust Services Criteria for security, availability, and confidentiality.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001 certification is currently in progress and not yet completed.

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27018 certification is currently in progress and not yet completed.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: The platform aligns with EU data protection requirements, with a Data Processing Agreement available and publicly maintained sub-processor list.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Business Associate Agreements are provided for Scale and Enterprise plan customers handling protected health information. Six core HIPAA-eligible services identified: realtime transport, recording/export, stream ingestion, agent hosting, agent observability, and conversational models.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: PCI DSS certification is currently in progress and not yet completed.

certifications.name: CCPA/CPRA
certifications.proof_quote: Compliant with California privacy regulations, including provisions for consumer data access and removal rights.

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework
certifications.proof_quote: Certified for lawful transfer of personal data between the EU and United States.

privacy.ai_training_note: LiveKit explicitly states: 'LiveKit does not use identifiable personal data, customer content, prompts, transcripts, or audio to train or fine-tune LiveKit's own models.' Limited exceptions: (1) Paid accounts: observability data NOT used for training unless customer opts into Model Improvement Program; (2) Free accounts: observability data may be de-identified and used to improve model accuracy; (3) Voice cloning samples: opt-out on customer's behalf from third-party provider training.
privacy.data_region: Configurable region pinning available for Developer Application Data, User Content, and region-matched Inference Data. Observability data processes in US regardless of region selection. Out-of-region inference providers and telephony operational metrics exempt from region pinning.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS/SSL for all connections; WebRTC native encryption for real-time media streams

security.name: Data Retention - Observability
security.value: Retained for up to 60 days by default; encrypted backups retained for an additional 30 days

security.name: Data Retention - Voice Samples
security.value: Retained for up to 12 months; deleted if no longer associated with an active voice clone

security.name: Access Control & Asset Management
security.value: Covered under SOC 2 Type II audit; includes policies for access control, asset management, physical security, and backup security

security.name: Vulnerability Management & Incident Response
security.value: Third-party security evaluations including pen test results available via Trust Center

security.name: Third-Party Integration Security
security.value: For inference features (STT, LLM, TTS), LiveKit acts as a conduit; does not retain inference inputs/outputs. Third-party providers follow their own data retention policies.

products.name: Agent Platform
products.data_scope: Agent code, voice/video streams, transcripts, observability data
products.notes: HIPAA-eligible for 6 core services. Supports inference via third-party providers (OpenAI, Google, Deepseek, AssemblyAI, Deepgram, Cartesia, Rime). Region pinning available.

products.name: Media Server
products.notes: Open-source option available. Handles media transport only; does not process or retain media.

products.name: Cloud Dashboard & SDKs
products.data_scope: Account metadata, API usage metrics, logs
products.notes: Multi-language SDKs (Python, Node.js, Web, Go, Ruby, Rust). Observability module included.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: Free tier (1000 session-minutes/month); Scale and Enterprise tiers with usage-based and reserved pricing
compare.data_residency: Configurable via region pinning for core data; observability data US-based; third-party inference providers may be out-of-region

flags: ISO 27001 not yet completed (in progress) — marketing homepage lists SOC 2 and GDPR as checkmarks, but ISO 27001 is not marketed, avoiding over-claim.
Observability data processed in US region even when region pinning is enabled — important for GDPR customers requiring strict EU data residency.
Third-party inference provider data handling is provider-dependent — LiveKit explicitly disclaims responsibility for inference inputs/outputs, noting it 'acts only as a conduit.'
HIPAA availability restricted to Scale and Enterprise plans with mandatory BAA — free and lower tiers cannot be used for PHI.
Free-tier observability data may be de-identified and used for AI/ML improvement — clear opt-in exists for paid tiers, but free users should be aware.
